$comment: Issue-title vocabulary for this repo. ONE source of truth, read by BOTH .github/workflows/issue-title-guard.yml and the PreToolUse hook ~/.claude/scripts/issue-title-hook.mjs, so the two cannot drift. Grammar is global (`area: description`); this list is not. NOTE: only 5 of this repo's first 59 issues carried any prefix, so this vocabulary was derived from what the titles are ABOUT rather than from prefixes already in use — see the areas below against `report`(13), `relay`(9), `ios`(8), `city`(8), `android`(7). Existing titles are not retroactively invalid; the guard only sees new ones.
